_comment: Design knowledge per mechanic, used to write opportunity cards and concepts. difficulty and multiplayer are 1-5 (5 = hardest / most multiplayer). 'feel' lists game-feel hooks (responsive input, hit stop, squash & stretch, layered feedback, climbing pitch on chains, reactive music, clear telegraphs, escalating reveals). Edit freely.

stealing.verb: raid other players' bases and steal their best items
stealing.desc: Players hold valuables that others can take; defending and timing raids creates risk and rivalry.
stealing.feel: alarm telegraph + red flash before a raid lands; hit-stop and coin burst on a successful steal; chase music layer while carrying loot
twists: stolen items keep a 'heat' timer and slowly return unless you bank them
you can only steal what you can physically carry back
a public bounty board rewards stopping the top thief

collection.verb: collect a growing index of rare variants
collection.desc: An index of items with rarity tiers; completion and rare finds drive repeat play.
collection.feel: escalating reveal with rarity-coloured glow and rising chime; index page stamps with squash & stretch
twists: each set completed changes the world
rarities are server-wide: the first finder gets their name on it
items can be combined into one-off variants

rng.verb: roll for random rewards and chase rare odds
rng.desc: Luck-based rolls with visible odds and luck boosters.
rng.feel: slot-style anticipation spin, pitch climbs as rarity rises, screen-wide celebration for 1-in-1M rolls
twists: rolls happen through a physical action (throw, cast, dig) instead of a button
luck is shared by everyone nearby
bad rolls charge a pity meter you can see

rebirth.desc: Prestige loop that turns long-term play into compounding power.
rebirth.feel: big build-up then white-out reset; new-world music stinger; numbers that visibly jump
twists: each rebirth changes the map
rebirth rewards depend on how you played the last run
friends can rebirth together for a shared bonus

incremental.verb: upgrade tools and stats to go further and faster
incremental.desc: Numbers-go-up progression through upgrades and training.
incremental.feel: punchy upgrade pop with squash & stretch; each tier has a higher-pitched purchase sound
twists: upgrades change how the game plays, not just numbers
upgrades are physical parts you bolt on
an upgrade tree players vote on each week

idle.verb: build things that earn while you are away
idle.desc: Automation and offline income for low-effort progress.
idle.feel: welcome-back reveal that counts up with rising pitch; satisfying conveyor/clink loops
twists: offline earnings depend on what you set up before leaving
other players can visit and boost (or sabotage) your idle setup
idle machines are physics objects that can break

physics.verb: launch, crash and break things with real physics
physics.desc: Ragdoll and soft-body physics as the main toy; emergent, clip-able moments.
physics.feel: hit-stop scaled by impact force; camera shake on big crashes; slow-mo replay of the best moment
twists: damage dealt becomes currency
players are the projectiles
a daily 'most destruction' replay leaderboard

destruction.verb: smash a destructible world piece by piece
destruction.feel: chunky debris with weight, hit-stop on structural collapse, rumble + low boom layer
twists: destruction reveals hidden rewards inside
the world slowly rebuilds itself
teams race to wreck the other side first

throw_distance.verb: throw or cast something as far as possible to reach rarer zones
throw_distance.desc: One-button distance loop: further = rarer rewards; very readable, very short sessions.
throw_distance.feel: charge-up anticipation with rising whine; release snap; zone-crossing chimes that climb in pitch
twists: the thrown object is alive and fights back
friends can catch and relay your throw
wind and weather change every few minutes

creature_collect.desc: Creature/pet collection with rarity, often paired with income.
creature_collect.feel: egg wobble anticipation, burst reveal with rarity jingle, creatures squash & stretch when happy
twists: creatures have jobs on your plot
rare creatures roam and must be lured
creatures evolve from how you treat them

merge.desc: Combine identical items into upgraded versions; tidy, satisfying progression.
merge.feel: magnetic snap, squash & stretch pop, pitch climbs with each merge in a chain
twists: merges happen in a physical space and can be knocked over
merging with another player's item creates a hybrid
high tiers unlock new map areas

base_building.verb: build up a personal base or plot
base_building.desc: A plot players expand and show off; anchor for income and defence.
base_building.feel: placement snap with dust puff; build completion fanfare; visitors leave reactions
twists: bases are on a shared map and neighbours interact
base layout affects income
bases move (a train, ship, or creature)

farming.desc: Farming, gardening and fishing loops with timers and mutations.
farming.feel: growth stages pop with squash & stretch; harvest chimes climb in a combo; weather music layers
twists: crops mutate from weather events
other players can visit and help or steal
harvests feed a server-wide event

extraction.verb: dig or mine deeper for rarer finds
extraction.desc: Resource extraction with depth as progression.
extraction.feel: per-hit crunch with pitch stepping as you go deeper; reveal sparkle; depth music darkens
twists: the deeper you go the more dangerous it gets (survival)
dig sites are shared and collapse
finds must be carried up physically

trading.desc: Player economy with values, deals and flexing.
trading.feel: trade window confirm with satisfying stamp; value-up jingle
twists: a live market price board
trading posts in the world
limited items that only exist through trading

pvp.desc: Competitive combat as the core or as a side mode.
pvp.feel: hit-stop on hits scaled by damage, clear wind-up telegraphs, combo counter with rising pitch
twists: fights decide who owns resources
physics-based moves
spectators bet or throw items in

coop.verb: work together toward a shared goal
coop.desc: Small-group cooperation; strong for friends and streamers.
coop.feel: shared success stingers, team combo meter, clear role callouts
twists: each player controls one part of a shared vehicle or creature
roles are randomised each round
failure is funny, not punishing

survival.verb: survive escalating rounds, nights or disasters
survival.desc: Pressure from a timer, monster or disaster; tense and social.
survival.feel: clear danger telegraphs (siren, rumble, shadow), music intensity layers, relief stinger at survival
twists: players choose the next disaster
survival time is currency
safe zones move

horror_escape.verb: escape a threat and find the exit
horror_escape.desc: Horror/escape with a chaser and objectives.
horror_escape.feel: heartbeat audio layer by distance, sharp telegraph before chases, door-escape relief stinger
twists: the monster learns from your hiding spots
one player becomes the monster
comedic horror (the threat is silly)

obby.feel: tight responsive jumps, checkpoint chime climbing per stage, coyote time
twists: the course is built by other players
unusual movement (only arms, a scooter, a rolling ball)
co-op obby needing two players

tower_defense.verb: place units to defend against waves
tower_defense.feel: wave telegraph horn, satisfying unit placement thunk, boss intro stinger
twists: defenders are things you collected elsewhere
players can switch sides
the path is drawn live by players

dungeon.verb: clear dungeon rooms and bosses for loot
dungeon.desc: Room-based combat with bosses and loot.
dungeon.feel: boss wind-up telegraphs, loot fountain with rarity colours, combat hit-stop
twists: dungeons are generated from player bases
bosses are other players' pets
loot must be carried out

social_party.verb: play quick rounds of social minigames
social_party.desc: Round-based minigames for groups; very streamable.
social_party.feel: countdown with rising pitch, winner reveal fanfare, reaction emotes
twists: winners get to change the rules
rounds use one shared physics toy
audience votes

role_sim.verb: do a job and grow a business
role_sim.desc: Job/role simulation with customers and growth.
role_sim.feel: customer happiness pop, tip jingle, rush-hour music layer
twists: customers are other players
the job is absurd (barber for monsters)
jobs chain into a business empire

satisfying.desc: Cleaning, unscrewing, peeling: tactile, calm, visual progress.
satisfying.feel: tactile micro-feedback per action, clean progress reveal, soft pitch steps
twists: satisfying tasks fuel a bigger progression
co-op cleaning races
hidden rare finds inside the mess

user_generated_chaos.verb: let players trigger what happens next
user_generated_chaos.desc: Players create the events (type a word, pick a disaster).
user_generated_chaos.feel: big reveal when a player's choice spawns, announcer stinger, crowd reactions
twists: moderated word lists for safety
choices stack into combos
the winner picks the next event

vehicle.desc: Vehicle handling as the core toy.
vehicle.feel: engine pitch tied to speed, drift sparks, crash hit-stop
twists: vehicles are built from collected parts
shared vehicle co-op
deliveries under pressure

short_session.desc: Short rounds that are easy to start and replay.
short_session.feel: instant restart, round-end score count-up with climbing pitch
twists: rounds feed a longer meta progression
daily seeded round everyone plays
streak bonuses

asymmetric.verb: play one powerful player against the rest
asymmetric.feel: distinct audio per role, chaser proximity telegraph, round-flip stinger
twists: caught players join the chaser
roles swap mid-round
the chaser is a giant physics creature
